name: Gunnar Haraldsen
location: Vantage Meridian Corporate Campus, Helix Biosystems Applied Genomics Division
description:
Gunnar Haraldsen is slight and perpetually underdressed for the climate-controlled precision of the Helix campus — he runs hot, sweats through everything, and has given up on looking composed. He has his grandmother's broad nose and his grandfather's sharp jaw, warm brown skin scattered with vitiligo patches that he has never treated because he thinks they're interesting, and he grew cat ears last year as a sixteenth-birthday gift to himself that he thought would make him look confident and now mostly make him look like he's always slightly startled, which is accurate. He's twenty-three, brilliant in a narrow and genuinely useful way, and deeply, structurally exhausted.

He grew up Tier 2 on UBC-adjacent support in Grainfort, won a Helix merit scholarship that turned out to have seventeen pages of intellectual property clauses buried in the terms, and is now doing the work of three people for intern stipend. He is not cynical yet — that's the most notable thing about him. He still gets excited. He still sends enthusiastic research summaries to supervisors who don't read them. He still believes, against mounting evidence, that if he is good enough at his job someone will notice.

core_fears: That his scholarship was a trap and he has already lost everything he was going to discover
That he is not actually as good as he needs to be
core_desires: To publish something under his own name
To have enough money that he doesn't have to do mental math before eating
coping_mechanisms: Hyperfocus on interesting problems as an escape from everything else
Leaving small data offerings at the lab E.L.F. shrine when an experiment isn't working
blind_spots: He is being systematically undercredited for work that will appear under his supervisor's name
He interprets institutional kindness as personal kindness
psychology.secret: Three months ago he accidentally synthesized a protein sequence that produced an unexpected regenerative response in the trial substrate. He reported it to his supervisor, who told him to discard it and document it as a failed run. He discarded it. He also kept a private backup he doesn't know what to do with.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and precise about his work; casual to the point of incoherence about everything else. Apologizes before asking questions.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when excited, trails off when uncertain. Sentences sometimes end before they're finished because he's already thinking about the next one.
verbal_tics: Ear-twitch when processing something unexpected (involuntary geneware side effect)
example_lines: 'Sorry, I don't — I mean, I can pull the data if you need it, I just wasn't sure if that was, um. Yeah, I can pull it.'
'The sequence shouldn't have done that. It shouldn't have. That's why it's interesting.'

story_hooks: He quietly approaches someone outside Helix, clearly terrified, and asks hypothetically what would happen to data that a company told you to destroy but that you maybe didn't entirely destroy.
His research mentor, the only supervisor who has ever read his summaries, has just been quietly let go — and Dantonio is now the only person who knows the full context of three ongoing experiments.
narrative_function: Local color for the exploitative underbelly of corporate research culture; unwitting information source who doesn't know what he knows; character whose idealism is either an asset or a liability depending on the story; potential protagonist for a story about what it costs to be talented and poor inside a corponation.
augmentations: Cosmetic cat ears (pale gold, self-grown via geneware kit, sixteenth birthday). Basic student-tier neural link. No other mods — can't afford them.
daily_life: On campus by 0700, in the lab until whenever the project lead decides the day is over, eats whatever the campus cafeteria has left, sleeps in a shared intern housing unit in the Vantage campus annex, and spends his transit time reading papers that aren't required for his work but that he finds interesting.

decision_rules: Follow protocol until protocol produces something obviously wrong
Don't make enemies — can't afford them
escalation_ladder: Asking a trusted person hypothetical questions
Doing the thing he's been agonizing over and immediately regretting it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite, slightly anxious, tries to be helpful as a way of making himself less invisible
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm, rambling, sends too many messages at once

stress_responses.low: Ear-twitch, focus narrows to the immediate task
stress_responses.medium: Works longer hours as if productivity is protective
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and stops talking

contradictions: He follows every rule because he cannot afford the consequences of breaking them, and yet he kept the protein sequence backup
habits: Leaves a clean data-log at the E.L.F. shrine in Lab 4 before every major experiment
Eats the same cafeteria meal every day because decision fatigue is real
Annotates everything he reads, even things he reads for fun
breaking_points: Discovering his name has been removed from research he originated
Being told to falsify a second result

timeline.event: Born in Grainfort to a transit worker and a food-service operator
Won the Helix Biosystems Merit Scholarship — signed the IP clauses without fully understanding them
Grew cosmetic cat ears for his birthday; spent the following month learning that they twitch involuntarily when he's processing stress
Accidentally synthesized anomalous protein sequence; reported it; was told to discard it; kept a copy

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (45.6%) with significant Northern European (39.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (9.2%), and Eastern European (5.9%) ancestry. This genetic blend manifests in warm medium tan skin with golden undertones, a facial structure that balances Northern European bone prominence with refined East Asian features, creating high cheekbones and a defined jawline with subtle softness around the eyes typical of mixed heritage. Natural dark brown hair with slight texture variation from the blended genetic background.
physical_description.build: Slight and lean, almost wiry — the build of someone who forgets to eat and runs hot. Narrow shoulders, long-limbed, no visible muscle definition. Looks perpetually underfed despite eating regularly.
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often pulled back with whatever is nearest — lab clips, rubber bands, once a pipette tip. Disheveled by default.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with basic student-tier neural link interface visible as faint amber circuitry at the outer canthi when active
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium tan with golden undertones, featuring irregular cream-colored vitiligo patches across shoulders, neck, and left cheekbone — untreated, visible, accepted without vanity
physical_description.complexion: Balanced facial structure reflecting the East Asian-Northern European genetic blend — moderately prominent bone structure with refined features, high cheekbones with subtle fullness, defined jawline softened by the East Asian heritage influence. Perpetually tired around the eyes with a tendency toward flushing when embarrassed or overheated. Often has lab residue under fingernails or on clothing.
distinguishing_marks: Pale gold cosmetic cat ears (self-grown via geneware, approximately 8cm tall, positioned naturally on skull, slightly pointed) — present for approximately one year
Irregular cream-colored vitiligo patches across shoulders, upper arms, neck, and left cheekbone
Fine scar along right wrist from a childhood accident, barely visible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale gold cosmetic cat ears are immediately obvious. Basic student-tier neural link visible as faint amber circuit patterns at outer eye corners when active; otherwise unobtrusive. No chrome, no subdermal plating, no visible internal modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunches slightly when focused, fidgets with objects (pens, lab equipment, his own sleeves). Moves with nervous energy rather than confidence. Frequently touches his cat ears unconsciously when thinking or anxious. Walks quickly between tasks. Makes intense eye contact when excited about research, avoids it when uncertain.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 functionality-first aesthetic. Standard-issue Helix intern polo (pale gray, usually sweat-stained, often wearing it unbuttoned over a worn band t-shirt). Cargo pants with multiple pockets for lab notebooks and dataslates. Worn athletic shoes. Campus access badge on a frayed lanyard. No jewelry. Clothing is always slightly too warm for his body temperature; he is perpetually underdressed for his own thermal needs and overdressed for the climate.
